verdict: Maybe, for a hardware team. Metashot pitched a console-like cricket game on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Cricket is India's biggest sport, and an interactive game that gets people moving is appealing, but consumer hardware is expensive to develop and support.
angle: Motion-sensing bats and games let families play cricket indoors. Hardware must be reliable and the games must keep players coming back. Gifting seasons and cricket tournaments bring sales spikes.
